summary: Premier Air Charter Holdings filed an 8-K reporting that lessors AB Jet Co I and VI terminated the two Cessna Citation CJ3 aircraft leases on October 1, 2026 and retook possession, citing uncured defaults. Notices claimed Premier owed approximately $249,416 and $265,141 plus approximately $129,797 and $137,044 for engine programs. The filing also includes an exit/disposal charge and officer departure under Items 2.05 and 5.02. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for liquidity strain, further asset disposals or wind-down, and whether the vacant officer role signals deeper distress.
